# Matt Pocock skills in Rein

Source: https://github.com/mattpocock/skills
Revision: `3cca18b368ae95cdbdebbff572ccafa662551015`
License: MIT, copyright 2026 Matt Pocock (see LICENSE).

The diagnosing-bugs, tdd, and code-review skill directories are unmodified copies.
manifest.json pins their content and supporting references. Rein exposes them
through its native skill tool and explicit /skill command; it does not execute
bundled scripts or configure an external issue tracker when loading a skill.
The user's current instructions and existing authorization take precedence over
the loaded workflow. No debug transcripts or credentials are part of this bundle.
